title: Model Ecosystem Signal Integration & Use-Case Concordance
creator: Aisha Patel
objective: Create an integrated signal-to-use-case concordance that maps continuous model-landscape signals (performance, availability, cost, quantization readiness) to customer-facing use-case suitability and automated fallback strategy recommendations.
background: We monitor hundreds of external model signals (latency profiles, quantization compatibility, license changes, region availability, performance on benchmark prompt sets). PM teams currently consume these as disconnected artifacts; SRE/Provisioning rely on manual triage. This ticket scopes a productized mapping layer and dashboard that helps Sales/Onboarding/Platform teams decide when to recommend hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deployments and which fallback model families to bind to a customer profile.
approach_summary: 1) Define a normalized signal schema and per-model capability taxonomy. 2) Build a concordance rubric that scores model suitability per canonical Redwood use-case archetype. 3) Implement lightweight ETL to ingest model signals and enrich customer profiles. 4) Expose outputs via a dashboard and an API for Console/Provisioning automation.
tasks: Define canonical use-case archetypes and required capability vectors (latency SLO, hallucination tolerance, context window, token cost)
Design normalized signal schema and scoring rubrics (compatibility, fragility, cost-sensitivity)
Prototype ETL: ingest model catalog snapshots, latency telemetry, quantization tests, and license metadata
Create concordance engine that emits per-customer recommendations and fallback chains
Design dashboard wireframes and API contract for Console + sales playbook integration
Write evaluation harness: synthetic workloads mapping to archetypes for validation
Document handoff: runbook for Solutions & Sales and API usage examples
deliverables: Concordance scoring rubric CSV and sample outputs
acceptance_criteria: Schema defined and approved by Research and Engineering leads
Concordance engine produces stable recommendations for 90% of evaluated scenarios
Prototype ETL runs end-to-end and refreshes model signals daily in staging
Dashboard mockups reviewed and usability feedback incorporated
Two customer-facing teams have signed acceptance (Sales Solutions and Customer Success)
success_metrics: Reduction in manual fallback triage time by 40% for pilot customers
Increase in correct initial deployment recommendations (hosted vs dedicated vs private) to 85%
Number of automated fallback activations with no customer-visible error >= 95% success in pilot
Adoption: 3 pilot customers using concordance recommendations in provisioning
risks_mitigation: Signal freshness risk: mitigate with daily ETL and staleness flags
False positives in suitability scoring: run safety thresholds and human-in-loop approvals for high-impact customers
License or provenance surprises: add mandatory license parsing and legal review gate
Operational coupling: keep prototype as read-only recommendation until automation SLA proven
notes: Prefer pragmatic schema that can evolve; avoid heavyweight ontology in v1
Tie scoring to real cost units (per-token, per-embedding) to make tradeoffs tangible
Make concordance explainable: every recommendation must include top-3 signals driving it
Store historical recommendations to measure drift and model churn impact
